{{About|the monster type|the divination card|The Skeleton|the skill gem|Summon Skeletons}} [[File:Skeleton.png|thumb|right]] A '''skeleton''' is a type of [[undead]] [[monster]] found throughout [[Wraeclast]] that attacks with [[melee]] [[attack]]s. The non-melee versions are known as [[Skeleton archer]] and [[skeletal mage]]. Note that there are melee skeletons that are classified as [[vaal construct (monster type)|vaal construct]] and not interactable with necromancers. __TOC__ ==Variations== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center;" |- !
